batting.dismissal: c DP Conway b RA Jadeja

batting.name: Dhruv Jurel
batting.dismissal: c S Dube b Akash Singh

batting.name: JO Holder

batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: DP Conway
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b YS Chahal

balls.text: Theekshana drops a sitter but Zampa is run-out! He scoops it high to short fine leg but he runs around and drops it. Regathers and throws it to Dhoni, who underarms a throw at the stumps. Royals have 175 on the board.
Holder finds deep midwicket to perfection! Slower one again, the offcutter at 123 clicks. Holder goes back and heaves across the line but finds Conway stationed there.
Once again rolls his fingers over that and bowls it at 125.6 kph on a length outside off. He only manages to hit it to cover.
Full and outside off, Hetmyer doesn't connect. Lands just short of Dhoni, who fails to collect that. Royals opt to review the wide. Well inside the guide line that.
Slower one on a length around off, Hetmyer hacks it wide of Santner, the sub, at long-on.
Bludgeoned! Full and wide outside off, Hetmyer moves across and gets under it. Smacks it right back over the bowler. Long-on and long-off have no chance.
Another full toss, Akash ends up dismissing Jurel. He skies it high and long-off comes in to pouch that easily. The umpires want to check the height of the ball and it is well below the waist.
Full and outside off, goes back and across and hacks it wide of long-on for one.
High full toss outside off, Hetmyer takes full toll of that. Goes deep inside the crease and makes good contact.
Full and wide outside off again, Jurel is already standing on off. Lofts it wide of long-off.
Goes wide of the crease and spears it full on off. Hacks it off the inner half to deep midwicket.
Full toss outside off, Akash gets away with it. Flatbats it to sweeper cover.
Streaky but effective! Length ball angling away at 130.1 kph. Hetmyer once again goes hard at that but ends up getting a thick outside edge over short third.
Now Deshpande fires this full and well wide outside off. Hetmyer lets it be and it's given a wide.
Hetmyer powers this over! Another full toss, well outside off. He is back and across pretty early. Cross-bates it for a 83-metre biggie over long-on.
Full and wide outside off, Hetmyer lets it be expecting a wide. Not given and rightly so. Passes marginally over the line and he had moved to off.
Length ball angling in on off, he goes back and heaves it all along the ground to deep square leg.
Goes for the wide yorker but dishes out a full toss well outside off. Hetmyer walks across and hammers it down to long-off.
Yorker outside off, he digs it back out towards the bowler.
Flatter in line of the stumps, he goes back and clips it through midwicket.
Tosses it fuller around off, he lunges and gets an outside edge.
Flatter around off, goes back and clips it through midwicket.
On a length outside off, he gets behind it and turns it to the on side.

Buttler loses his off stump! Tosses it up generously and lands it on a length outside off. Dips enough to pass under Buttler's attempted swipe across the line. Uproots the off stump and Moeen has his sweet revenge.
Fuller on the pads, he works it away towards short fine leg.
Flatter outside off, and he goes back and clips it through midwicket.
Fires it full on off, he lunges and gets an inside edge onto his pad as he looks to smother it.
Quicker on the pads, worked away through square leg.
Flatter and quicker at 100.5 clicks on middle and leg. He turns it through midwicket for one.
Quicker and flatter on the pads, turns it wide of short fine leg.
Quicker on the pads, turned through square leg for a brace to bring up yet another half-century.

And that's that for Ashwin with the bat tonight! Goes back and across to the length ball. He looks to heave it over mid-off but ends up skying it straight to Magala there. Magala hurt his finger while taking that.
Akash spears it full and very wide. Ash covers his stumps and lets it be.
Full and outside off again, Buttler walks towards off and hits it to deep cover.
Full and outside off, he backs away and slices it through backward point.
This is long and in the same region! Chepauk cheers for one of its own now. Another length ball on middle and leg, he clears his front leg and deposits it over deep midwicket.
Ashwin deposits this over deep midwicket! Back of a length, off pace as well. Ashwin goes deep back and hacks it across the line.
Slower one on a length, angling away. Buttler adjusts and slaps it through covers.
Drills it back down! Full and outside off, he dashes down and hits past the bowler for a couple.
Fuller outside off, eases it to deep cover.,
Length ball on middle, cuts it off the outer half towards short third for a quick one.
Slices it through the gap between short third and backward point. Quicker and fuller on leg, he backs away and gets it through the gap for four.

Huge mix-up but a very wide throw at the keeper's end. Ashwin charges down and mistimes it to the left of Moeen at cover. He rushes through for a run but is sent back. Moeen collects it but fires it wide of Dhoni.
Flatter on middle and off, he goes back and works it away through midwicket.
Fuller outside off, he pushes it towards point and keeps strike.
Full on leg, he lunges and works it away through midwicket.
On a length around off, goes back to push it through cover.
Flatter on leg, knocks it through wide mid-on.

Dhoni is lightning quick in whipping the bails off! Sent upstairs. Tossed up fullish around off, Ashwin misses the drive down the ground because of the turn away. But he never lifts his back foot from inside the crease.
Floated down leg, he misses the flick
Darts it in on a length on leg, he goes back and works it away through midwicket. Wanted a second but it wasn't on.
Very full on the pads, he flicks it through square leg.
Ashwin goes deep back in his crease but gets a low full toss in line of the stumps. Knocks it down to long-on.
Back of a length on off and middle, he pulls it in front of square on the on side and collects two more.
Shortish and angling in, he works it away through backward square leg.
Full and outside off, he walks down and across and flicks it through mid-on.
Full and outside off, driven to long-off.
Fullish on the pads, he looks to turn it across but gets a leading edge to the off side.
Quicker and fuller on the pads, wristed away through square leg.
Floated full around off, he inside edges the attempted reverse sweep.
Gets forward and drives it to long-off.
Fuller around off and middle, he goes back and defends it towards cover.
Ashwin goes back and defends this.
Fullish around off, drives it to long-on off the front foot.
Length ball on off, looks tp pat it towards point and run but it's straight to backward point.
Bangs it short but it goes down leg. Ashwin goes for the pull but misses.
Full on middle and leg, he flicks it to long-on. This was at 142.4 kph.
Length ball just around off, Ashwin steers it to deep third.
Length ball on off, just a hint of nip inwards. He knocks it down to long-on.
Starts with a shortish ball around middle and leg, Buttler wrists it through square leg for a couple.

Moeen grasses Ashwin first ball! Jadeja can't believe it. Another quicker one around off, Ashwin plays at that with hard hand and gets a thick outside edge. Goes straight to slip and Jadeja was almost off on his celebratory run only to see it go down.

Jaffa from Jadeja and Samson has to walk back! What a ball that. He bowls it on a length around off and middle and gets it to straighten just enough. There good bounce on that and Samson has no time to adjust and gets beaten on the outside comprehensively. The noise at Chepauk is deafening!
Quicker and flatter outside off, he hangs back and cuts it to short third.

Jadeja gets Padikkal! An impressive little knock ends prematurely. Tosses it up and lands it on a length outside off, he has to fetch the sweep from outside off. Ends up top-edging it straight to Conway at deep backward square leg. The 77-run stand ends.
Flatter and outside off, cut to backward point.

Conway does well. He was running to his right from deep square leg but almost over-runs it because of the spin. Does well to prevent the boundary. Padikkal moves across and slog sweeps it forward of square on the on side.
Another one! This is easy pickings! Drops it short again, allows Buttler a lot of time to go back and hammer it into the deep midwicket stands.
Bashed away! Half-tracker outside off, turns in a touch. Buttler goes back and pulls it over deep midwicket.
Quicker and fuller on leg, swept to backward square leg.
Quicker and outside off, he goes back and slaps it to sweeper cover.

Padikkal tries to take him on but gets a thick outside edge! Dances down and looks to go over the off side, slices it through vacant short third. Magala chases it down from backward point and saves one.
Tosses it up and bowls it full outside off, he goes back and pats it towards cover-point for one.
Fuller on the pads, at 102.7 clicks. Flicks it through midwicket to retain strike.
Quicker and on a length just outside off, steers it wide of short third.
Flatter and on e length outside off, he goes back to cut but misses. Extra bounce there.
Flights it and bowls it full on leg. Buttler eases it through midwicket via the inner half.
Fires it down leg again, Buttler lets it be this time.
Bowls it on a length, angling away. Padikkal goes back and slaps it through cover-point.
Comes back well. Lands it on a length around off, Buttler goes back and punches it through wide mid-off.
Poor start! Fires one in down leg, Buttler looks to heave but misses. Tough for MS to collect that either.
Slower one full on off and middle, he flicks it towards mid-on tobring up 3000 IPL runs.
Length ball around middle and leg, he is squared up a bit but opens the face and gets it towards short third, where Magala keeps it to one with a dive.
Angles it on a length on middle and leg, he tucks it to fine leg.
Lands it on a length on the pads, flicks it through backwared square leg for one.
Poor ball now. Bowls it on a length on the pads, he tucks it well past short fine leg.
That didn't come off the meat of the bat but the timing is good on that. Length ball around off, Padikkal slinks down and hacks it back past the non-striker. Beats mid-off, who cannot stop that.
And Buttler goes hard again! Darts it quicker and on a length outside off. It was at 98.2 clicks. Buttler goes back and slices it well over cover-point.
Full on off, driven through wide mid-off for one.
Beautifully driven. Padikkal is enjoying is promotion. Makes room early, gets a full ball on middle and off. Times his drive through covers and finds the gap.
Quicker in line of the stumps, turns it to the on side and scampers for a quick one.
That's a proper Buttler hack! Tossed up on a length outside off, he clears his front leg and tonks it over long-off.
Has Moeen grassed this? Was very quick and very low to him, hit his left shin on the full. It was quick and full just outside off, Padikkal steered it straight to slip. Almost.
Another slower one, on a length around middle and leg, turns it towards midwicket to keep strike.
Another slower one, full on off, Padikkal has to wait before pushing it to cover.
Full and straight on middle and leg at 106.6 kph, Buttler drives it past the non-striker and sprints to the other end before mid-off gets around.
Outside off on a length, he glides it to deep third.
In the air but safe. Full and angling in, he flicks it aerially towards the vacant deep midwicket region and collects two.
Full and outside off, drives it to deep cover-point.
Quicker on off, he gets his bat down in time and stubs it to the off side.
Darts it in on a length, punches it to mid-on.
Almost deceived him in flight but Padikkal is fortunate there. Gets forward and is done in by the turn. Pokes at that and gets a thick outside edge past slip. Short third couldn't pull it in.
Excellent shot that. Theekshana comes from around the stumps and floats it fyll on off and middle. Padikkal drives it all along the ground through extra cover.
Darts it full around off, gets it to spin in. Buttler wrists it to square leg and takes a quick one.
Bowls it quicker and fuller around off, he eases it down to long-off.
Full and fast outside off, Padikkal hangs back and steers it to deep third to get going.
Full on off, driven straight to mid-off.

Deshpande strikes and Jaiswal is out of here! It's an excellent back of a length ball, angling away outside off. Jaiswal had his weight on the back foot and looks to heave it to the on side. Ends up getting it high on the bat and slices it towards mid-off where Dube makes no error.
Length ball angling away outside off, Jaiswal lofts it over wide mid-off. Dube gives it the chase and saves two.
Full and outside off, a hint of outswing there. Buttler leans into it and drives it to sweeper.
Starts with a length ball outside off, that moves away a touch. He covers the stumps and shoulders arms.
Fullish and outside off again, drives it straight to cover-point. Decent start from Akash that.
Full length ball outside off, drives it towards covers where the fielder dives and stops that.
Hits the deck and angles it in on the pads, and pays the price. Jaiswal times his flick through forward square leg to perfection.

Oh dear! Theekshana makes a hash of that fielding attempt. Length ball outside off, he stands tall and punches it past backward point. Deep third covered good ground to his left, slid but let it through.
Full and swinging away outside off, he goes for an expansive drive but misses.
Has it done enough? Huge appeal from Akash, turned down! Full and straight around off, he misses the flick and is hit on the front pad, but he was way down.
That's as good a yorker you will see last ball of an innings! Nails his yorker on off. Dhoni tries to get under it, but just can't. Drags it to deep midwicket. Rajasthan Royals win by three runs.
Pin-point yorker outside off, he can only dig it to covers. Only a run.
Length ball outside off, he was looking to heave it away again, but this time can only drag it to deep midwicket. Just a s single. Dhoni does not look 100% fit.

SIX, SIX! MSD is in his 200th game as captain is turning the screws. Low full toss in middle. He stays deep his crease and swings it over deep midwicket. Just over the ropes. The crowd has gone delirious.
Gets it wrong and Dhoni just helps it all the way! Low full toss on the pads of Dhoni who whacks it to the vacant deep fine leg fence. Absolute skimmer that goes all the way for six.
Oh, that's a top-notch yorker right on off stumps. Nothing that Dhoni could have done. Digs it to the bowler.
Strays down leg this time around, two wides in a row.
Nerves, nerves! He was trying the slower bouncer, loses his radar altogether. Way outside off.
ALL THE WAY! This ain't over. Length ball on middle and this time Jadeja gets under it and smokes it straight down as the ball just clears the ropes.
Excellent yorker under Jadeja's bat outside leg. The batter was backing away and could not get underneath it.
heaved away all the way! Length on the pads of Jadeja, who just smokes it deep over the fine leg fence. Just picks it up effortlessly
Sprays that one well down leg, Samson does well to move his right. Jadeja not happy he did not get any bat on that.
Slammed back straight over as Jadeja finds the boundary. Length on middle, he clears his front leg and hammers it over Dhoni's head. No stopping that.
Excellent full ball outside off, he can only whip it down to long on.
Good length ball on leg stump as Jadeja back away looking to swipe it away. He misses as the ball lobs towards the off side.
Flatter on middle and leg, he gets across and works it to deep midwicket for a run
Flatter just on off and middle, he goes and works it to long on
Vintage Dhoni! Tossed up outside off, right in Dhoni's arc. He lines it up and hammers the slog sweep over deep midwicket.
Short on off as Jadeja goes back and hammers the pull but deep midwicket is placed to perfection
Ooh, that stays low but Dhoni picks it up nicely. Pulls it to deep backward square leg.
Fired on the pads and Dhoni gets the sweep out to just help it to the fine leg fence. That will get the crowd going.
Flatter outside off, he punches to cover. And Chahal's spell is done.
Length that was fired on off stump. Dhoni cuts it off the stumps to point.
Edged and gets away with it. Pushes the loop length ball away from the batter's arc. Jadeja tries the slog sweep, gets a thick edge just past the keeper
Quickish length ball on off and middle, he pushes it to long on
Flicks it uppishly but not hit as hard. Fuller on the leg stump. He whisks it towards long on.
Flatter good length ball on off, he slaps it to deep cover off the backfoot.
Flatter, 95.6 kph delivery right on off that can only be patted back to the bowler.
A hint of turn on off stump, he goes back and works it behind square for a run
A touch quicker outside off, he opens the face of the bat towards point
Flatter on middle stump, he stays back and pushes it to long on
Pushed through on leg stump, he goes back and bunts it to the left of midwicket.
Flatter on middle and leg, he works it to deep midwicket.

Conway departs and things are looking even tougher for CSK now! Tossed up outside off, Conway looks to go over cover but the angle meant he could not reach it properly. Ends up skewing it straight up as Jaiswal backtracks from extra cover and completes a well-judged catch.
Flatter on middle and leg, he works it to deep backward square leg.

Ooh, gets that to turn into the batter, who was looking for a massive slog. Instead he gets it off the inside half of his bat past short fine for three. The fifty is also up for Conway off 37 balls.  Important that he stays in till the end.
Pushes the length ball very wide. Conway can't reach it and called a wide.
Whipped away with disdain! CSK will need a lot of these. Fuller on middle stump. He whisks it to the left of long on
Knee-high full toss to start off that is flicked away to deep backward square leg by Jadeja

Another one bites the dust! Rayudu makes no impact whatsoever. Short of a length ball on middle and leg. He romps back looking to clear the field, but does not get it off the middle. Hetmyer runs to his right from deep midwicket and completes an excellent catch. They are catching everything, are RR and CSK are losing the plot.
Fuller outside off, he goes an expansive drive, gets a thick inside-edge past his stumps.

Oh, that's an excellent catch from Sandeep Sharma running across from deep backward square leg. Tossed up ball on middle stump. Moeen goes for the slog sweep, but does not get it anywhere close to the middle. I thought he had placed it well but Sandeep sprinted across so well.
Fuller on middle stump, he lines up for the sweep, but Zampa gets it underneath his bat. The inside edge goes to short fine leg
Pushed quicker outside off, he taps it to point and they take a run
Cuts it over backward point uppishly but over the fielder's head. Short and wide, he gets it off the toe end of the bat but got enough bat to clear the fielder.
Skids this one outside off, he flays it to extra cover
Short and very wide, he lines up for the cut but the ball kept turning away from him. He misses.
Loops this one well outside off as Conway sweeps it to deep midwicket, where the fielder misfields but there was another fielder backing him, thankfully.
Flatter on middle and leg, he works it towards midwicket as the bowler gives chase.

Misses the ball, loses his grip on the bat, not a lot going right for Moeen tonight. Oh, looks like Moeen got a tiny edge on that short of of a length ball outside off. But Samson fails to hold on. He was trying to hack it away.
Pushed through on middle and leg, he goes back and flicks it to deep midwicket for a couple of runs.
A touch short outside off, he goes back and slaps it hard to extra cover
Darts that one on middle and leg, he works it to wide long on
Flatter on middle, Moeen as he taps it to covers

Oh, what a bowler, Ashwin! Now, gets the one that fizzes quickly into the pads of Dube. He was just not expecting it and is caught plumb in front of the stumps. The umpire's finger is up in a flash and Dube does not review.
Floated the length ball well over the batter's eye line outside off. But that was quite a bit away from the tramline
Off-break outside off, but that was right in Dube's arc as he frees his arms and hammers him straight down. But that was so powerfully struck that long off had no chance
Flatter length ball down the leg, called a wide

Flatter short of a length ball outside off. Probably saw Dube come down the track and pushed that wide holding his length back. Dube tries to cut, misses as Samson whips off the bails. The third umpire is called to check the stumping. Dube's foot is down.
Short of a length ball on off that is hacked to the bowler
Pacy back of a length ball, around hip-high to Dube who was already outside the line of leg stump. He can only tuck it towards deep backward square leg.
Slower off-cutter on middle and leg that is worked away towards square leg.
Another back of a length ball just outside off. Dube stays leg side of it and taps towards point.
Back of a length outside off, he cuts it to the left of point. And they pinch a single again.
Banged in short outside off, he just dabs it to the right of point, who dives and saves at least a run
Good length ball outside off, he cuts it hard to deep point
Flatter trajectory again outside off, he hacks it to cover.
Goes for the reverse sweep does Conway to the length ball outside off. Gets his off the gloves to the right of short third.
Flatter length ball on middle, he stays leg side of it and punches it to long on

Loud, loud appeal as Rahane misses and is rapped on the pads! The umpire agrees and Ashwin is over the moon.  Pre-meditated slog sweep from Rahane, but Ashwin pushed that carrom ball through and on middle and leg. Rahane misses and once that happened it was always going to be trouble. He does not opt for the review. Wasn't too impressed by his shot.
Flat length ball just outside off, he goes back and cuts it hard past point
Tossed up off-break on the pads of Rahane who clips it to the left of short fine leg.
A touch short on off, he goes back and flat-bats it hard to the left of the bowler. That was absolutely nailed by Conway. But long on does well and keeps it down to two.

Oh, so close to the leg stump! Flatter down leg, it hits his pads and just misses the leg stump. Hang on, CSK have reviewed asking that to be a wide. Looks like the ball did not hit his pad at all. Excellent review, the third umpire says that is a wide.
Oh, shot! Dances down the track and absolutely hammers the length ball through covers. No stopping that one for sure.
Short ball as Rahane goes back and once again mistimes the pull to the right of Holder, who does well. Oh, Conway is struggling at the non-striker's end but the the throw was not up to the mark
Steps down the track, but is beaten by the wrong'un as he clogs it in the gap to the right of long on. He was deceived completely, was looking to go straighter, instead drags it
Fuller-length ball outside off, he goes forward and pushes it past the bowler to long-on
Gets that to turn as touch from outside leg as Conway clips it to the on-side with soft hands. They take two. Excellent running.
Slower full-length ball on middle and leg, he works it towards deep midwicket for a run.
Full-length ball on the pads of Rahane who clips it elegantly but straight to deep backward square leg. The fifty of the partnership is up as well off 33 balls.
Length just outside off, he opens the face of the bat to the right of point. They take a run, and make it easily as Zampa misfields.
Back of a good length this time as Rahane lines up the pull from outside off. But does not get enough bat on it. Hacks it to deep backward square leg.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, as he works it to deep backward square leg. They think about a second but the fielder came in quickly.
Nah, not the ideally length and Conway obliges! Low full toss on Conway's pads who flicks it away past short fine leg
Full on middle and leg, he shimmies down the track and whisks it to long. That shot had a bit of flair in it.
long-hop and Conway has absolutely muscled it away! Outside off, was very slow as well. Conway goes back and hammers it to the left of long-on. The fifty is up as well.
Fuller on middle stump, he was looking to drive straighter, but the mistimes it uppishly to the right of Chahal. Was uppish but away from the bowler.
Quicker length ball on middle, he goes back and flicks it to long on
Tries his hands at the reverse sweep, drawing a big appeal from Chahal. The umpire shakes his head. Think Conway got an inside-edge there.
Flatter on off, he plays it back to the bowler
Just a touch slower now on middle stump, he works it towards the midwicket fielder for a run
Angles the length ball on off, he defends it
Pushed quicker on off, he taps it to long on
BANG! That's as good a shot as any all match. Length outside off, he jumps down the track, extends his arms and sends it soaring over mid-off and eventually over the ropes.
A bit of leading edge as there is a hint of turn on leg stump back to the bowler
Tossed up outside off. He lofts it over the in-field over covers. Did not get enough bat, but enough to clear covers.

Dropped at backward square leg by Sandeep. Was a difficult chance, but should have been taken! Flat, quick and on leg stump from Zampa. Conway goes for the sweep again, but does not get enough height. Sandeep leapt in the air, got both hand, could not hold on.
Gets closer to the stumps now, bowling it quick and flat. Patted back to the bowler
Swept fine and for four! Flatter again down leg. He gets inside the line, and sweeps it late past short fine leg
Dances down the track but Zampa probably saw him coming and gets that full on leg. He can only dig it towards deep square leg.
Length outside off, he goes back and hacks it to point. Was darted in again.
Darts than one quicker on middle stump, was 96kph. Rahane can only push it back to the bowler.

Oh, he controlled that so well. Angles the good length ball into the batter, but gets than one on the hips of Conway. He just helps it around the corner past short fine leg. Never tried to hit that hard.
Length but the line is straighter and easy pickings for Rahane who works it to deep backward square leg.
Banged in short that does not bounce as much. Sits up easily for Rahane who picks up length early and pulls him over midwicket.
A touch fuller on middle stump as Conway gets across and clips it to deep midwicket.
Pacy length ball angled into Conway, who can only defend back to the bowler.
Cuts him in half first ball. Back of a length ball just outside off as Conway looks for a pull. But he is beaten for pace a touch as the ball goes through him
Slower off-cutter on off and middle. He works it towards midwicket and takes a run. Conway slipped while going for the run but gathered himself well in the end.
Length right on off stump, not a lot of swing. Rahane pats it to point and Conway sets off for a quick single.
Length on middle and leg, Conway clips it neatly and with soft hands behind square looking for a second. Not on, though.
Good start for Rahane. Short, wide, and he cuts the ball hard to point, who misfields and they get three.

Straight up, goes very high and Jaiswal has taken a very good catch! Length ball with just a hint of shape away from Gaikwad, who closes the face of the bat a touch too early. Takes the leading edge of his blade and balloons straight up. Jaiswal runs in from cover, calls early and takes the catch, rather comfortably.
Good length with a hint of shape into Gaikwad, who drives on the up but to the left of mid-off
In the slot for Conway outside off, and he drives imperiously straight down but can't beat mid-off.
Dances down the track to the 142.1kph length ball on middle. He laces the cover drive but straight to the fielder.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, he pushes to point and searches a run. But, Gaikwad sends him back.
Raps him on the pads with that length ball but the line was down leg and they take a leg-bye
Back of a length ball just outside off, Conway taps it to point and sets off.
Digs the first one in around shoulder-high. Gaikwad arches back and opens the face of the bat to ramp to deep third.
Gets to move that length ball into Gaikwad again, who works it to long on
Another gentle short of a good length ball but the line is very straight and Gaikwad easily flicks him past short fine leg. That was just 125ks

Balloons it straight up but gets enough bat to clear mid-off. Was a length ball on off, he takes a couple of steps down and lofts it straight up. He gets more height than distance. Chahal runs back but can't quite reach.
Gentle length ball with a bit of tail away from Gaikwad. Not a lot of pace but some swing, for sure. Gaikwad is opened up a touch but defends.
Good length ball outside off, he scythes it to cover

A bit of inswing first up and a loud appeal rightaway! Not given out, and Samson has a word with his bowler. But Gaikwad was quite a bit down the track and even though he missed, and was rapped on the pads, he made sure to get outside the line.
